SessionManager: canonical conversation history [session-manager.ts]
|
|-- Owned tree state: fileEntries + byId + leafId
|   |-- SessionEntry.id / parentId connect the selected root-to-leaf path
|   `-- Messages, settings, custom entries, summaries and context edits
|-- appendMessage() / appendCustomMessageEntry()
|   |-- <- AgentSession message_end; streaming deltas are not separate entries
|   `-- Bash execution and summary message kinds are persisted elsewhere
|-- _persist(): optional JSONL storage
|   `-- Initial flush waits for a user or assistant message; later writes append
|-- buildSessionProjection(entries, leafId, byId)
|   |-- Selected path + latest compaction -> retained context entries
|   |-- ContextEditEntry -> replacement content or omission from model context
|   `-- Projected messages + model/thinking metadata + source-entry provenance
|-- buildSessionContext()
|   `-- -> SDK restores Agent messages; request projection rebuilds canonical input
|-- appendCompaction(summary, firstKeptEntryId, ...)
|   `-- Context becomes summary + retained entries; underlying history remains
|-- branch(entryId) / branchWithSummary()
|   `-- Select an alternate continuation without rewriting old history
`-- createBranchedSession(leafId)
    `-- Copy the selected path into a separate session for runtime fork
